Leighton Welch increased its stake in Range Resources Corp (RRC) by 107.6% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Welch Capital Partners Llc bought 61,760 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.12% with the market. The hedge fund run by Leighton Welch held 119,160 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.03 million, up from 57,400 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Welch Capital Partners Llc who had been investing in Range Resources Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $3.70 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.53% or $0.08 during the last trading session, reaching $15.2. About 7.57M shares traded or 1.68% up from the average. Range Resources Corporation (NYSE:RRC) has declined 48.60% since May 28, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 60.15% the S&P500.
